data.content_ref: inline:Introduce a commitment-root validity oracle: require every accepted node to have a shortest defense path to a committed root, and strengthen acceptance by requiring the path to be witness-minimal under a polynomial-time canonical ordering. This gives a graded notion of commitment and makes reinstatement a property of path-minimality. Criticizable because shortest paths may not capture argumentative reinstatement, and the canonical ordering may be manipulable by adding redundant defense paths.
